items.title: Sound Out Short Vowel Words
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can say 'The first sound is __, the middle sound is __, the last sound is __' and 'I blended the sounds to read __'.

items.title: Plants Need Light
items.subject: science
items.lo: I can explain what happened to a plant by saying 'The plant in the ___ is ___ because it got ___.'

items.title: Find the Main Idea of an Informational Text
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can say 'The topic is ___. The main idea is ___. One detail that supports it is ___ because ___.'

items.title: Place Value to 100
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can explain why one number is greater by saying 'is greater than because it has more tens'.

items.title: Greetings and Feelings in Spanish
items.subject: world-languages
items.lo: I can ask '¿Cómo estás?' and answer 'Estoy ___' with a partner, using a feeling word such as feliz or cansado.

items.title: Primary and Secondary Colors in a Composition
items.subject: arts
items.lo: I can describe a painting by saying 'I see ___' and 'The artist used ___ to ___', and give a classmate feedback with 'I notice ___ and I wonder ___'.

items.title: Compare Characters by What They Do
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can explain how two characters are different by saying 'Nia ___, but Theo ___' and prove it with 'The story says ___.'

items.title: Multiplication with Arrays and Equal Groups
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can explain an array by saying 'There are ___ rows with ___ in each row, so ___ times ___ equals ___'.

items.title: Solving Word Problems With Visuals
items.subject: sped
items.lo: I can explain my steps by saying 'First I read, next I draw, then I write an equation, last I check.'

items.title: Explain How Water Moves
items.subject: esol
items.lo: I can explain the water cycle in order by using 'first, next, then, finally' and 'because'.

items.title: Water in Our Community
items.subject: interdisciplinary
items.lo: I can explain the path of water using first, next, then and finally, and give a reason for saving water using because.

items.title: Energy Transfer and Simple Circuits
items.subject: science
items.lo: I can explain how energy moves in a circuit by using 'first, next, then, finally' and 'because the circuit is open' or 'because the material is an insulator'.

items.title: Maryland's Regions and the People Who Lived with the Land
items.subject: social-studies
items.lo: I can compare two regions with 'both' and 'but', and explain how land shaped people's lives with 'because' and 'so'.

items.title: Opinion Writing with Reasons and Evidence
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can link my reasons and evidence with 'for example', 'because' and 'in addition', and answer another view with 'however'.

items.title: Nutrition Labels and Choices
items.subject: health-pe
items.lo: I can compare two labels by saying 'Snack A has more ___ than Snack B per serving' and explain my choice with 'I would choose ___ because ___'.

items.title: Adding Fractions with Unlike Denominators
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can explain how to add fractions with unlike denominators by saying 'because the pieces must be the same size' and 'I rewrote ___ as ___'.

items.title: Central Idea and Supporting Details
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can explain a central idea by saying 'The central idea is that ___ because the author ___' and connect a detail to it with 'This shows ___ because ___'.

items.title: Ratios and Rates
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can explain why two ratios are equivalent by saying 'for every' and 'because both numbers were multiplied by'.

items.title: Variables and Relationships
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can explain a relationship between two quantities by saying 'as ___ increases, ___ increases by ___ each time' and justify my equation with a row from the table.

items.title: Note-Taking and Summarizing
items.subject: sped
items.lo: I can write a summary by using 'The text is mostly about ___. One key detail is ___. Another is ___.' in my own words.

items.title: Evaluate an Argument
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can evaluate an argument by saying 'This evidence is relevant (or not sufficient) because ___' and balance my judgment with 'Although ___, ___'.

items.title: Argue With Evidence From Text
items.subject: esol
items.lo: I can argue a claim by writing 'The text states ___, which shows ___' and by answering an opposing view with 'However, ___'.

items.title: Proportional Relationships and Graphs
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can justify a claim about a relationship by saying 'it is proportional because ___' and by naming evidence from a table or a graph.

items.title: Plan a Small Budget Project
items.subject: cte
items.lo: I can justify a budget change to a team lead by saying 'The plan costs ___, which is over our limit by ___' and 'I propose ___ because ___'.

items.title: Chemical Reactions and Conservation of Mass
items.subject: science
items.lo: I can write a claim, evidence and reasoning statement using 'because' and 'this shows that' to explain a mass measurement.

items.title: Causes of the American Revolution: Sourcing the Evidence
items.subject: social-studies
items.lo: I can explain a cause and its effect using 'Because ___, ___' and judge a source using 'This source shows ___, but it cannot show ___ because its maker ___'.

items.title: Rhyme and Syllables
items.subject: ela
items.lo: I can say 'cat and hat rhyme' and 'butterfly has three claps' using words I hear.

items.title: Describe School and People
items.subject: esol
items.lo: I can describe a picture by saying 'I see a ___' and 'It is big' or 'It is small'.

items.title: Count and Compare to 10
items.subject: math
items.lo: I can say 'This group has more', 'This group has fewer' or 'The groups are the same' to compare two groups.
